items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I worked with Bud. Because I worked with Bud quite a bit around here... And I worked with him with a couple of bands around there.

ctx.x: I think St. Cyr is on most of those, but I believe Bud Scott, do you remember? Did you record Bud Scott? Bud Scott, let's see. On banjo or guitar or some of them? Seems to me like Bud Scott was with, now was he with us when, with Lil, when we recorded with Lil? I think St. Cyr was on that date, I'm pretty sure. I think he said, he's heard those and told me that. But I think some of those with Johnny Dodds with Jelly Roll and Baby Dodds, I believe maybe, doesn't sound like the banjo that St. Cyr, I think it might…

I worked with Bud. Because I worked with Bud quite a bit around here. Oh, with Jimmy Noon, was he with you then too? Yes, no, he was with, with me down here with Dave Payton had a band in Cabaret, Cafe de Paris. One place down in the old Royal Garden. Oh yes, I heard of that. And he was with us then. And then I think, who else was it? Some other band I worked with, Bud Scott. I can't think. I don't know whether it was Cook. No. I don't know whether it was Cook or not, but I think. Anyway, Bud was around in those…
See, Johnny Lindsey was the bass player on those Jelly Roll records. Yeah. Yes, yeah.
